clusters.title: PD-disagg servers segfault at startup on the new ROCm 7.2.x images — 2 legs, 2 test files each

cause_prs.author: Lzy17
cause_prs.title: [Fix] [AMD] mooncake: Bump Mooncake to v0.3.14-rc1 for cross-node KV transfer

details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`:

In both IF disagg jobs, `test_disaggregation_basic.py` and `test_disaggregation_pp.py` hit `Fatal Python error: Segmentation fault` during decode graph capture / PD warmup, then `Server process exited with code -9` (the scheduler subprocess itself exited with −11).

The native frames differ by lane. rocm720 crashes in `c10::hip::HIPStream::stream()`. rocm724 crashes in `rocr::AMD::GpuAgent::ReleaseQueueMainScratch ← hsa_queue_create`. The rocm720 run also logs `OSError: …/pa_ragged_…/lib.so: cannot open shared object file`.

The rocm720 disagg leg in E [passed](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39054460168/job/117459520981) on `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.22-rocm720-mi35x-20261017`. Both failing legs ran the `-20261018` images.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[LOW]`: the change is in the `-20261018` images. If they were built from Oct 18 `main`, they include the Mooncake bump [`8a4239fb`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/8a4239fbdcd7dedb5a4cf96ba17a0cec558bae2b) ([#44404](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44404)). Oct 17's code (`4eb606b2`) does not include it.

details.label: Disconfirming
details.text: the faulting frames are in HIP and ROCr, not Mooncake. I have not diffed the image contents. 68 code commits also landed in [`4eb606b2..4ec19ca2`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/compare/4eb606b2ae...4ec19ca27f).

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ❌ none found. I searched `disaggregation segfault` and `test_disaggregation_basic`; [#43299](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43299) is related only.

details.label: Suggested triage
details.text: rerun both legs at `4ec19ca2` on the `-20261017` images. If they pass, A/B the Mooncake bump inside the new image. If they fail, bisect the 68-commit window.

details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`:

`test_krea2_fp8.py` fails with `AttributeError: type object '_FakeFABackend' has no attribute 'get_impl_cls'`. `_FakeFABackend` is defined only in test files: `test_attention_backend_selector.py:58` and `test_qwen3vl_text.py:34`.
In the failing shard (3), 35 `test_attention_backend_selector.py` tests ran before krea2.
In F the krea2 test ran in shard (0), without the selector tests, and logged `Using Torch SDPA backend … PASSED`.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[HIGH]`: `_cached_get_attn_backend` (`multimodal_gen/runtime/layers/attention/selector.py:442`) keeps the fake class after the selector test finishes. The tests were reshuffled into shard (3) on Oct 18. **Disconfirming**: I have not reproduced it locally.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ❌ none found. I searched `attention_backend_selector`, `_cached_get_attn_backend` and `krea2`.

details.label: Suggested triage
details.text: locally, run `pytest test_attention_backend_selector.py test_krea2_fp8.py` in one process. If krea2 fails, clear the selector cache on teardown.
